OpenAI is launching ChatGPT specifically designed for teenagers, calling this new initiative "an experience aimed at helping young people learn, think critically, deepen their understanding, and confidently use AI." ChatGPT for Teens can be activated when OpenAI's system estimates the user's age to be between 13 and 17, or when the user directly indicates their age.

OpenAI highlighted four features launching alongside ChatGPT for Teens:

  • Study Mode, which helps teenagers understand educational content through guided questioning and step-by-step support.
  • A new responsible homework reminder feature that can identify when teenagers attempt to take shortcuts to complete assignments, directing them to Study Mode for a step-by-step collaborative problem-solving process.
  • Quiz and learning visualisation features that provide teenagers with more ways to practise, test what they have mastered, and gain clearer understanding of difficult concepts to evaluate learning outcomes.
  • In addition, through the new Study Hours feature, teenagers or parents can choose to preset Study Mode activation during specific times, making it easier to cultivate good study habits and integrate them into daily life.

At the same time, ChatGPT for Teens also includes the following safety and protection measures:

For teenage users, protection features are part of the default experience. For users under 18, ChatGPT for Teens employs age-appropriate safeguards designed to reduce exposure to potentially harmful or developmentally inappropriate content, while preserving the ability to learn, create, and explore. […] This work also builds on our earlier family tools featuring parental controls and notifications. Parents who have linked their teenager's account can set quiet hours, manage specific settings, and receive safety notifications in limited high-risk situations. We are adding additional notifications related to eating disorders, while restricting shared content and focusing on key moments when offline support may be most important.

OpenAI also detailed how ChatGPT operates for users under 18, which includes the following healthy use measures:

  • Sensitive image upload reminders, alerting teenagers not to share private or sensitive images.
  • An introductory guide designed specifically for teenagers that introduces them to the available learning and safety features from the very beginning.
  • Simple personalisation options, such as theme colours and voice variations, that help create a personalised experience without blurring the line between practical tools and interpersonal relationships.
